title: Founder
html:
• Founded and built RunAgent, an agent-native cloud platform that makes it easy for developers to run AI agents in production.
  • Architected secure, scalable micro-VM–backed services with full streaming support for Python-based agent deployment.
  • Developed language-agnostic SDKs with built-in authentication, observability, and memory capabilities.
  • Enabled seamless integration of AI agents into real applications and workflows without infrastructure complexity.

title: Founding Engineer
html:
• Key contributor to scalable system architecture and backend development as a founding engineer.
  • Designed and integrated AI capabilities to enhance system intelligence.
  • Developed connectors to different Database & Data Warehouse applications.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
html:
• Building production grade LLM tools and integrations for Agentic Workflows.
  • Developed and implemented advanced parsers to generate tools for large language models (LLMs).
  • Programmatic tool generation, improving efficiency and accuracy in handling complex data structures.
  • Developed integrations with cutting-edge agentic platforms, enabling seamless workflow integration.
  • Conducted research benchmarks on LLM function calling accuracy; published findings.
  • Core contributor to the ComposioHQ/composio, OSS initiative to integrate AI Agents with a comprehensive toolset for enhancing agentic workflows and achieving high accuracy in tool calls.

title: Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer
html:
• Developed SOTA Bangla ASR, TTS, OCR systems.
  • Working towards Bilingual LLM, RAG & seamless interoperability between Bangla & English.
  • Solving Industry AI use cases in Bangladesh.
